_comment: The good case (LAW 38): the node pool grown to 4 OCPU / 24 GB. Two OCPU and 12 GB are paid: (2 * 0.01 + 12 * 0.0015) * 730 = USD 27.74 a month, under the USD 50 cap in estate-defaults.yaml.
